company.description:
Company overview
BusinessBOX is a one-stop advisory firm… We decided to start our adventure to provide entrepreneurs smartly tailored business services in the fields of Business and Financial Advisory; Branding & Design; Marketing; Digital Transformation and Training.

Our advisory firm’s name is a visualization of our Raison D’Etre. We envision handing our clients an empty box in which they can throw their burdens and send it back to us. We then unload and refill it with beautiful hand crafted solutions. Allowing our clients to focus on their core business To reach their full potential activities.

The blue shade in the logo reflects the trust our clients place in us. The yellow is inspired by our optimism to bring positive change to our clients. With attention to balance and objectivity that are signified by the gray color.

Our vision
Striving to reset the standards of simplicity and efficiency in the business services industry

Our purpose
To serve businesses in a way that allows them to devote more of their time, resources and effort on what they do best

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $250,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,509,961 to $1,509,961, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 25 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
